decisions.reason: As a core airfield-lighting control product with a dedicated launch and clear strategic fit in airport electrical infrastructure, it is likely to stay in the portfolio despite the aviation downturn.
A surveillance display is a relevant complement to the firm's airport systems offering, though it has a somewhat higher rationalization risk if folded into a broader surveillance solution.
Training services are more vulnerable to weak airport spending after COVID, but they still support the installed base and are usually retained unless replaced by a broader program.
A narrowly defined training course with only limited website prominence is the kind of offering management would most readily discontinue or absorb into general training services.
Collaboration software supports airport efficiency and digitalization, so it remains strategically useful even if commercialization may have been slowed by the pandemic.
A newly launched multilateration surveillance system is a high-value, long-cycle airport technology product that a German industrial firm would usually continue backing rather than withdraw quickly.
